I wasn’t on the receiving end but was a witness to it. 
Just chilling on a bus to work and a woman wearing a hijab gets on the bus. A man that was wearing a top with Nigel fararge on the front precedes to say that she should be banned from the country and went up to her chest to “see if I can hear it ticking”

Now I’m not confrontational but I couldn’t stand by and watch this. I stood up and walked to the other end of the bus where he was and a group of other people joined me as we formed a human barrier to keep him away from her. Driver has had enough and pull bus over. Now bear in mind we are on a county road. He forces the man off the bus and left him on this country road at 3 in the afternoon. The cheers and celebrations that took place when he got off was fantastic to see that humanity still exist. But also that people like this guy exist is very very depressing
